Prices

Questions

How much do projects in cloud, data and security cost?
An MVP in this group costs $500–20,000 (UZS 6–245 mln), a full version up to $65,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 1–10 weeks, a full version 2–24 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Access to servers and accounts; A description of the current system; A technical contact.
